$comment: Tone → visual style. Edited by hand; no code change needed to retune it.
A tone is a description of DELIVERY measured locally from the audio (loudness
and pitch relative to the speaker's own median, speaking rate, pauses). It is
NOT emotion recognition. Keep the styling restrained: if a viewer can tell
which rule fired, the rule is too loud.
fontFamily  a family name from `caption-engine fonts`. Omit to inherit.
bold        true forces the real bold face. Omit to inherit.
scale       multiplier on the word's size. Keep within 0.9-1.15;
anything larger fights the active-word scale and reflows lines.
color       #RRGGBB. Omit to inherit the base caption colour.
minConfidence gates the whole system: a word whose tone was classified below
this keeps the base style. Raise it if styling feels twitchy, lower it if
nothing ever triggers. Tones are only applied with --prosody.
